title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 401) reviews: Families still await return of abducted Oyo pupils

content.rendered:
More than two weeks after dozens of pupils and teachers were abducted from schools in Oyo State, many of the victims remain in captivity despite ongoing rescue efforts.

The situation has fueled public frustration, with Nigerians questioning the speed of the response from authorities and calling for urgent action to secure the release of the victims and restore confidence in school safety.

#viralpost #sothishappened #SchoolAbduction #OyoState #Insecurity #NigeriaNews
